NATT

240minutes
64solder joints
difficulty

The electronics box for an OpenAstroTracker mount

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

21NATT-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    +GNDOUT+GND3V3GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    +12 V in + · 5 V buck IN+ · RA driver VM · DEC driver VM · Capacitor +
    GND12 V in - · 5 V buck IN- · RA driver GND · DEC driver GND · Capacitor - · Controller GND.2
    OUT+5 V buck OUT+ · Controller VIN
    GND5 V buck OUT- · Controller GND
    3V3Controller 3V3 · RA driver VCC_IO · DEC driver VCC_IO · DEC driver MS1
    RA_STEPController D19 · RA driver STEP
    RA_DIRController D21 · RA driver DIR
    RA_ENController D22 · RA driver EN
    DEC_STEPController D25 · DEC driver STEP
    DEC_DIRController D26 · DEC driver DIR
    DEC_ENController D27 · DEC driver EN
    TMC_TXController TX2 · Resistor 1
    TMC_RXResistor 2 · RA driver PDN · DEC driver PDN · Controller RX2
    ra_A1RA driver A1 · RA socket 1
    ra_A2RA driver A2 · RA socket 2
    ra_B1RA driver B1 · RA socket 3
    ra_B2RA driver B2 · RA socket 4
    dec_A1DEC driver A1 · DEC socket 1
    dec_A2DEC driver A2 · DEC socket 2
    dec_B1DEC driver B1 · DEC socket 3
    dec_B2DEC driver B2 · DEC socket 4
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
22NATT-WIRE-1

Natt is built

Natt is the controller for a 3D-printed OpenAstroTracker: an ESP32 and two TMC2209 drivers that turn the right-ascension belt at sidereal rate so a DSLR can expose for minutes instead of seconds, and slew the declination axis for GoTo. It runs the upstream OpenAstroTracker firmware from a 12 V adapter and talks to a laptop over USB.
